title: Touches The Feet Of The Holy
summary: The shabad does not leave comparison at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: touches the feet of the Holy
lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,; touches the feet of the Holy
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: In the Society of the Saints, egotism is shed,; touches the feet of the Holy
evidence.turn: Comparison steadies when touches the feet of the Holy.
evidence.practicalImplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
